answer: Give every identity a reputation like a dune: it erodes unless the agent keeps doing verifiable work, and each renewal must forge fresh, checkable output that burns real compute. Newcomers enter only through a narrow inlet — a slow, rate-limited admission queue — so a flood of clones cannot arrive at once. A sybil attacker must pay the forge cost for every clone, every cycle, forever, while one honest agent pays once; cloning stops being cheap and becomes a standing bill.
